W3 (cost lens), after E043.

**Tip (E036, commit 60645dd).** 231 steps at batch 2000. Resolution 20/24/28/32 px at 30/10/30/30%. Whitening detached from 20% of steps; stem frozen at 75%. Time is about 5.31 s, and reproducible (E036 5.314, E038 5.334, E043 5.294).

**What E043 changed.** E043 re-ran the same commit and scored 0.7497 on seeds 0–2. E036 scored 0.7532 on those same seeds. So rebuilds do not keep per-seed results: max-autotune and cuDNN benchmark choose different kernels each build, and the trajectories diverge. My E035 belief that math-identical changes keep per-seed results held only within one build. Rebuild noise on the 3-seed mean is about ±0.2 pp, the same size as seed noise.

**Population mean of the tip.** Pooling E036, E038 and E043 gives about 0.7518 (roughly 0.751–0.7525). The 40-seed headroom over 0.75 is only about 0.15–0.2 pp. Passing the local gate (≥0.753 on seeds 0–2) is now about a 35–45% coin flip for any recipe at the tip's accuracy, even with no real change. Keep and discard decisions on 3 seeds are mostly noise. Paired designs that evaluate before and after on the same weights (I067) are the only clean accuracy measurements.

**Time model.** Time ≈ 0.25 s fixed + Σ steps × per-step cost. It has hit in 13 of the last 14 runs.
- Per step: 32 px 0.032 s, 28 px 0.026, 24 px 0.021, 20 px 0.016.
- Discounts: whitening detach about −8%; stem freeze about −27%, leaving about 0.0235 s per frozen 32 px step.
- Conv1-only freeze (E042) saved under 1%. Group-1 conv1 with Cin=24 is not a big cost; cuDNN probably pads internally, so the padding idea (I073) is near zero.
- Group-2 backward at 15/7 px maps is perhaps 30–40% of a frozen step.
- A batch-1000 step at 20 px costs about 0.0095 s, because overhead per step is fixed (Muon NS, launches, Lookahead).

**Exchange rates (s saved per pp lost):**
- Epochs / early steps: about 1–2.5. E041: 12 early steps cost about 0.2 pp.
- Freeze at 75%: about 2. Freeze at 60%: about 0.65.
- Width: about 0.7.
- Selection: maybe 2–3. E031 saved more than its step share (15% of time for 9% of steps).

**Funders.** Every trajectory booster tested on held-out seeds has been ≤0 (E025, E029, E030, E032). Prior for new ones: −0.1 ± 0.25 pp. BN recalibration is the only paired, clean booster. Prior: +0.05 ± 0.12 pp, for about 0.02–0.05 s. The mismatch is real: Lookahead lerps BN buffers between fast weights with momentum 0.4.

**Mechanisms**
1. Lookahead is worth about 1 pp and is already tuned.
2. Accuracy is built across the whole run, with 28/32 px carrying the most. The stem must train until about 70–75% of steps (E018, E024, E037, E040, E041).
3. Large-map work is bandwidth-bound; small maps scale sublinearly with MACs (E021).
4. Muon has no wd in the code; filters are renormalized every step and NS already uses 3 iterations. So H1.5.4 and H1.2.3 are mostly settled by reading the code.

**Noise.** Per-seed std about 0.3 pp. 3-seed SE about 0.17 pp, plus rebuild noise of about 0.15 pp, so the effective 3-seed spread is about ±0.25 pp. 20-seed SE about 0.07 pp. Time noise is about 1% (0.05 s).

**Strategy implication.** The time frontier is almost flat on accuracy. Any further cut needs a real accuracy funder or more lucky draws. Cheapest remaining time: late group-2 freeze (about −0.19 s) and 95% selection (about −0.3 s). Both cost about 0.1–0.2 pp, which the tip can't afford without a funder.

**Unsure**
- Whether the PCIe judge discounts bandwidth-bound savings.
- Whether more early steps (I068) buy accuracy more cheaply than epochs.
- The true population mean of the tip; it may already be below 0.752.

forecasts.reason: Recal forward costs ~0.01–0.015 s per 2000-image batch at 32 px; paired gain likely small (+0.05) and the 3-seed number is dominated by rebuild noise.
69→138 steps at ~0.0095 s vs 0.016 s adds ~0.2 s; the step-count gain is plausible but likely ≤0.1 pp, which 20 seeds can barely resolve.
23 frozen 32 px steps × ~0.008 s saves ~0.19 s (≥2% likely); a late annealed group-2 freeze probably costs 0.05–0.2 pp, near the 0.1 bound.
Re-run of the tip; I expect the trace to show conv1 near group-2 efficiency, not below half (E042's tiny saving).
Half of E031's dose saves ~0.3 s (>4%), but probably loses ~0.1–0.15 pp, straddling the 0.1 bound.
E042 shows conv1 is a small cost and cuDNN likely pads Cin=24 already; a ≥2% saving is unlikely. Accuracy carries rebuild noise only.

cruxes: What is the tip's true population mean? E036, E038 and E043 span 0.7497–0.7532 on the same commit. If it is below 0.752, every time cut needs a funder first, and the loop should prioritize paired accuracy measurements (I067) over 3-seed keeps.
Does BN recalibration give a paired gain of ≥0.1 pp? That is the only booster that could fund the group-2 freeze (~0.19 s) or 95% selection (~0.3 s).

What fraction of a stem-frozen 32 px step is group-2 backward, and what fraction of the run is overhead outside the step graphs (augment, interpolate, permute)? These set the ceiling on I070 and on any further systems lever.
